name: Doxycycline
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Binds the 30S ribosomal subunit and inhibits protein synthesis, covers atypicals, rickettsiae, chlamydia

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Doxycycline, oral, 100 mg 12 hourly for 6 weeks.
Doxycycline, oral, 100 mg 12 hourly for 2 days.
Doxycycline 100 mg, oral 12 hourly for 21 days.
Doxycycline 100 mg, oral 12 hourly for more than 21 days may be required for complete resolution of disease.

dosing.h: Laboratory-based testing when syphilis rapid tests are unavailable or inappropriate

items.t:  If penicillin stock levels are insufficient, give Doxycycline 100mg 12-hourly orally for 14 days • If the rapid test is positive and there are NO symptoms or signs of syphilis, send a confirmatory blood sample to the laboratory for a syph
Doxycycline, oral, 100 mg daily for 3 months. · Review patient after 3 months of treatment. · It should be taken with meals.
Doxycycline, oral, 100 mg 12 hourly, for at least 3 days after the fever subsides with clinical improvement. · Maximum duration of treatment is 7 days.
Doxycycline, oral, 100 mg 12 hourly for 14 days .
Doxycycline, oral, 100 mg 12 hourly for 30 days .
Doxycycline, oral, 100 mg once daily for a maximum of 3 months.
Doxycycline, oral. · If < 50 kg: 4 mg/kg/24 hours in 2 divided doses on the first day, then 2 mg/kg/24 hours in 2 divided doses for second day.

contraindications.t: Children under 8 years (except short courses for rickettsial disease)

cautions.t: Swallow with plenty of water, upright
Absorption reduced by iron, calcium and antacids

adverse_effects.t: Nausea, oesophagitis, photosensitivity, tooth discolouration in young children
